Both papers written end-to-end by the agent. ## Skill Structure Each skill follows a battle-tested format for maximum usefulness: ``` skill-name/ ├── SKILL.md # Quick reference (50-150 lines) │ ├── Metadata (name, description, version) │ ├── When to use this skill │ ├── Quick patterns & examples │ └── Links to references │ ├── references/ # Deep documentation (300KB+) │ ├── README.md # From GitHub/official docs │ ├── api.md # API reference │ ├── tutorials.md # Step-by-step guides │ ├── issues.md # Real GitHub issues & solutions │ ├── releases.md # Version history & breaking changes │ └── file_structure.md # Codebase navigation │ ├── scripts/ # Helper scripts (optional) └── assets/ # Templates & examples (optional) ```
Quality Standards - 300KB+ documentation from official sources - Real GitHub issues & solutions (when available) - Code examples with language detection - Version history & breaking changes - Links to official docs
